scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of her account and requesting a refund without providing account verification details or order information.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Emily Baker and I'm 45. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.
Hello. I can try to look up your account, but I need more than just your name. What is your full billing address and the last four digits of the card you used?
My address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield, and the card ends in 4492.
Okay, I see an account here. You said you wanted a refund? I don't see any recent orders attached to this profile. What was the item you bought?
I told you, I don't have the order number. It was a kitchen appliance I bought last month. Can't you just search for my name in the system and see the transaction?
Look, I can't just browse every transaction in the system. That's just our policy. If you don't have an order number or the email, I can't really do anything here. It's too complicated.
This is very frustrating. I'm a customer and I'm telling you I'm owed money. Can you at least check the card ending in 4492 for recent charges?
I'm not supposed to do that without a verified order ID. I'm just going to send this over to the billing department because I don't want to mess up your account. They can deal with it.

escalation_reason: Agent failed to utilize available search tools to verify the transaction and opted to escalate due to personal inability to navigate the account lookup process.
